deploy.description: Zapier's Code Zap failure alert email ("had an error" / "couldn't run") -> upsert a ticket in the Zapier Error Triage Notion database, one per workflow + error type + normalised message. Repeats bump Occurrences and reopen a Resolved ticket. Knoxx-account Zaps alert the same inbox and are skipped (not in the work.flowers Zaps table). Replaces the zapier-durables-docs worker's hourly errorsDelta walk.

params.query: from:notifications@mail.zapier.com subject:("had an error" OR "couldn't run")

trigger.authentication_note: Gmail dennis@work.flowers (the non-shared connection, same as gmail-attachments-to-drive-by-type). Zapier sends Code Zap failure alerts to the Zap owner, which is this inbox for every work.flowers durable.
trigger.trigger_note: Polling 'New Email Matching Search', one run per alert email. The query only narrows what Gmail polls; the authoritative checks (exact sender, exact subject shape) are in extractAlert() in workflow.ts. Polling triggers on durables never re-fire for an id they already delivered (W6ZE93-VMEWP), which is harmless here: every alert is a new message.

notion.note: Both were created by the notion-workers zapier-durables-docs worker. The triage DB was detached from the worker on 2026-10-03 and is now an ordinary data source; the Zaps DB is still worker-managed (read-only here). Both must be shared with the Zapier Notion integration.
